label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is bar which is derived from user input param, and although encoded for HTML at the sink, the XSS vulnerability exists because the encoded value still originates from attacker-controlled data. Alert 2 (java/sql-injection): alert-TP — resolved sink sql concatenates bar which is derived from user input param, making it vulnerable to SQL injection. Case TP: at least one alert-TP.

evidence.note: getParameter reads user input into param
doSomething modifies param through list operations to bar, which is used in SQL and HTML contexts
SQL query constructed with bar (which contains user input) leads to SQL injection
HTML output includes bar (which contains user input) leading to XSS
